integrity: The theorem is proved by an exact per-ballot identity for SAV and PAV one-vacancy scores. A separate standard-library verifier checks the identity over all ballot types through eight candidates and exhaustively checks 57160 small profiles with exact rational arithmetic.
scientific_limitations: The exact equivalence is restricted to nonempty approval ballots and committee size one less than the number of candidates. It does not extend as stated to arbitrary committee sizes, sequential PAV, or reweighted approval voting.
title: PAV collapses exactly to SAV when a committee leaves one candidate unelected
